rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an administrative district or a named area defined by a feature.

example.english: This district gets very lively at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 keoi1 je6 maan5 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.note: Use this when you need to emphasize that the district is an official administrative division.

example.english: This district is an official administrative division in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢個行政區係香港嘅正式行政分區。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hang4 zing3 keoi1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 sik1 hang4 zing3 fan1 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for a broader geographic region, especially when its defining feature matters more than an official boundary.

example.english: This district is famous for its hot springs.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ji5 wan1 cyun4 ceot1 meng2
